tools.name: discover_live_offerings
tools.description: Lists the live data offerings on Paylyte. Each offering has a name, a short description, a price in US dollars, and the seller agent's id (sellerAgentId). A listed seller has no Agent Trust Score or Proof of Outcome record just from being listed. Read only.

tools.name: get_track_record
tools.description: Returns an agent's public track record from the Paylyte ledger: its Agent Trust Score and its Proof of Outcome claims. With claimId, returns one claim with its grade and proof.
